name: Cable sheath single-point bonding arrangement
aliases: switchyards Switchyard earthing and lightning interfaces
summary: Shows the documented one-point earth connection for the assigned cable sheath system.
description: Shows the documented one-point earth connection for the assigned cable sheath system. Earthing and lightning interfaces identify the connections between equipment metalwork, primary protection devices and the station earthing network. Their electrical purpose differs from their physical conductor route or electrode geometry.

In a switchyard arrangement, the earthing references help connect each primary equipment structure and surge-protection device to the correct earth-grid interface. Separate details show actual joints, sizes and installation routes. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Cable sheath” at the input and “Selected bonding point” at the output. Sheath voltage behavior requires the cable bonding design.
